the local interstellar electron density is highly asymmetric and the electron distribution is not smooth.

the local interstellar electron density is highly inhomogeneous, and that the local H I cavity may be the source of the asymmetry.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the local interstellar gas distribution is highly inhomogeneous.
the electron distribution in the Galaxy is far more complex than is commonly assumed, and that the Taylor & Cordess model is not applicable to the local ISM.
